snippet.title: Kung Fu Addiction - Gameplay Update
snippet.description:
🕹️ Wishlist: https://tinyurl.com/KungFu-Addiciton
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620860/Kung_Fu_Addiction/

Kung Fu Addiction is an auto-battler combat game with rogue-like elements and meta-progression. Predict your opponent’s next moves, earn attack, and defense points to unleash powerful special techniques. Master the art of anticipation in a thrilling single-player campaign or dominate multiplayer PvP matches. Level up your fighter, unlock new abilities, and climb the ranks.
